name: Cisco Nexus (NX-OS)
description: Cisco Nexus NX-OS switches. vPC, port-channels, BGP/OSPF, Ethanalyzer, AAA, FEX, multicast, and system health.
notes: Most commands require network-admin or a privileged role.
Ethanalyzer captures are bounded; press Ctrl+C to stop early.
Use 'terminal length 0' or the NX-OS equivalent to avoid paging.

categories.name: Connectivity
categories.description: Ping, traceroute, route, ARP, and interface status.

categories.name: Switching
categories.description: vPC, port-channels, LACP, STP, MAC, and FEX.

categories.name: Routing
categories.description: BGP, OSPF, routes, and next-hop checks.

categories.name: System health
categories.description: CPU, memory, logs, environment, and processes.

workflows.title: Ethanalyzer — host to host
workflows.summary: Capture a bounded packet sample for a host pair with Ethanalyzer and save it to bootflash.

steps.command: ethanalyzer local interface {iface} capture-filter "host {src} and host {dst}" limit-captured-frames 500 write bootflash:tstcap.pcap
steps.note: Bounded to 500 frames. Saves a pcap on bootflash.

steps.command: ethanalyzer local interface {iface} capture-filter "host {src} and host {dst}" limit-captured-frames 100
steps.note: Shows a short live sample on screen. Press Ctrl+C to stop early.

notes: Copy the pcap off the switch with 'copy bootflash:tstcap.pcap scp://user@server/tmp/' if you need a packet tool.
The capture is bounded, so no debugs are left running.

workflows.title: Connectivity check
workflows.summary: Ping, trace, route lookup, ARP, and interface summary.

workflows.title: vPC health and consistency
workflows.summary: Check vPC peering, keepalive, role, global consistency, and port-channel state.
notes: Check the peer-link first: a down peer-link suspends vPC member ports.

workflows.title: Port-channel and LACP
workflows.summary: Inspect a port-channel, member links, LACP neighbors, and configuration.

workflows.title: BGP neighbor health
workflows.summary: Inspect BGP summary, one neighbor, advertised routes, and the BGP RIB.
steps: show bgp ipv4 unicast neighbors {neighbor} advertised-routes

workflows.title: OSPF neighbor and route health
workflows.summary: Check OSPF neighbors, interfaces, and learned routes.

workflows.title: RADIUS server status
workflows.summary: Inspect RADIUS servers, statistics, AAA groups, and authentication configuration.

workflows.title: RADIUS debugs
workflows.summary: Enable NX-OS RADIUS and AAA debugs for an authentication failure.

steps.instruction: Trigger the authentication attempt, then inspect the log.

notes: The final 'no debug all' is a safety net. Review the command reference for your NX-OS release.

workflows.title: System health snapshot
workflows.summary: Version, resources, CPU processes, environment, and recent logs.

workflows.title: Interface triage
workflows.summary: Check link state, counters, errors, and configuration for one interface.

workflows.title: Spanning tree and MAC table
workflows.summary: Inspect STP state, MAC learning, and interface status for a loop or blackhole.

workflows.title: FEX and fabric extender status
workflows.summary: Check fabric extender connectivity, host interfaces, and FEX details.

workflows.title: Multicast routing status
workflows.summary: Inspect PIM neighbors, multicast routes, and IGMP groups.

workflows.title: NAT translations and statistics
workflows.summary: Inspect NX-OS NAT translations and counters.
